findingDetails.title: The hub capability matrix advertises page.on(...) events as a working Aside capability, while the Aside packet documents that page.on throws on the pinned version
The hub README frontmatter carries version 1.1.3.0 while every other hub metadata file and the newest changelog entry carry 1.1.2.0

results.summary: The version-authority rule holds for every file it names except the README, recorded as finding R4-P2-009
Phase 014 AC-012 holds inside the Aside packet but not at the hub, so the checklist row is scoped too narrowly
The hub declares no agent definition of its own and the parent-skill checker 12a-router-contract and 12b-routing-shape invariants pass

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new and neither refines an earlier one: iterations 1 to 3 reviewed the advisor scorer, the install and capture scripts and the goal criteria, this iteration reviewed the hub prose, so weightedNew 6 of weightedTotal 6.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: 507 pre-bound files; this iteration narrowed to the hub root prose and the Aside packet lines it contradicts

targetSelection.selectionReason: The hub is the artifact every phase shipped into, so the maintainability dimension reads the hub root prose against the mode packets it delegates to
